new_result.statement: If a fixed original-coordinate pair block B is invertible indefinite and a disjoint bank principal block of the Schur complement has rank one with sole nonzero eigenvalue magnitude s, then every affine perturbation has density cap 8sqrt(5)(|det B| sigma_min(B) s)^(-1/4), uniformly in all pair-bank/outside couplings, shifts, dimensions, supports, fragments and moments.
